title: Choose the look of Digix
question: One direction is assigned, with alternates beside it. Keep it, take another, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Enamel Number Plates
options.lineage: Vitreous enamel street and house-number plates, found in cities worldwide
options.thesis: A code deserves the permanence of a number fired onto a plate: glass fused to steel, legible from across the street.
materials: fired cobalt enamel with a domed gloss
options.viewport: A large enamel plate holds the master switch; each action below carries its own smaller plate with its code.
options.risk: If the gloss is overplayed it turns into skeuomorphic costume instead of a clean Material app.

raised.raise: One geometry drives everything: the plate silhouette is the switch, the code, and the screen transition.
One colour is reserved for what is live, and nothing else may use it.
Every claim sits beside proof: each action shows whether it works on this phone and its last real run.
The actions are a finite roster, each with a fixed plate and one plain line about what it does.
Every state reads without colour: on, off, needs setup and failed differ in shape and words too.

options.label: Code of Signals
options.lineage: The International Code of Signals, where a short hoist of flags means a whole sentence
options.thesis: A short code that means a whole action is exactly what signal flags have done across every language for 150 years.
materials: numeral pennants in a vertical hoist
options.viewport: A white screen where each action's code flies as a small hoist of numeral pennants beside its name.
options.risk: Very distinctive, but busy with many actions, and flags need learning while plain numerals read instantly.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.lineage: Carbon-copy airline ticket coupons, with official stamps for every state
options.thesis: Each dialed code is a coupon: validated when it ran, and stamped VOID when the call was stopped.
options.viewport: A stacked wallet of coupons with the master switch on the top stub.
options.case: Fuses cleanly because a stopped call really is a voided ticket. It holds on clarity but loses on audience identification, since few people today know paper tickets.
options.risk: Reads as nostalgia, and hairline coupon forms get cramped at large font sizes.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.lineage: Neutral-scale software marketing with one rare accent
options.thesis: Almost no colour, with every sentence followed by proof.
options.viewport: A neutral list with one accent on the live state.
options.case: Clear but anonymous: it could be any settings app, which loses identification and adds no clarity.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.lineage: Swelling flat-colour lobes of a garden guide map
options.thesis: Each area of the app is a lobe of colour.
options.viewport: A green lobe swelling across the screen.
options.case: Joyful, but a watch remote has no territory to map, so it loses on both axes.
options.kept: One geometry drives layout, art and state together.
options.risk: Whimsy undermines trust in a call-handling app.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.lineage: ISOM map inks and numbered control descriptions
options.thesis: Numbered controls checked off in one reserved purple.
options.case: Precise but niche, and a route metaphor implies a sequence that these codes do not have.
options.kept: One colour is reserved for what is live.

options.label: Character Goods Catalog
options.lineage: Ranked pastel rosters of rounded mascots
options.thesis: Each action is a character with a one-line personality.
options.case: Charming, but it trivializes something that intercepts your phone calls.
options.kept: A finite roster where each member has fixed furniture.

options.label: Exposure Record
options.lineage: Darkroom printer's records and zone ramps
options.thesis: State shown as hatch density on translucent sheets.
options.case: Too dense and specialist for a one-minute setup, so it loses on both axes.

canonCard.label: Clean Material You
canonCard.thesis: A familiar Android utility: dynamic wallpaper colour, standard lists and switches, executed perfectly.
canonCard.viewport: A top app bar, a switch card and a list of actions.
canonCard.risk: Trustworthy and native, but indistinguishable from any other utility.
